actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.runExtract.description: Run an extract/workflow on an uploaded document
Number of pages per segment for method 1 segmentation
actions.runExtract.props.detect_tables.d: Detect tables in the document (requires use_ocr=true)
actions.runExtract.props.document_id.des: The unique identifier of the document to parse
actions.runExtract.props.end_regex.descr: Regex pattern for where parsing should end (requires use_ocr=true)
actions.runExtract.props.query_model.des: The AI model to use for parsing
actions.runExtract.props.split_regex.des: Regex pattern to split the document into sections (requires use_ocr=true)
actions.runExtract.props.start_regex.des: Regex pattern for where parsing should begin (requires use_ocr=true)
actions.runExtract.props.template_id.des: The unique identifier of the Workflow/template to use
actions.runExtract.props.use_all_matches: Use all regex matches instead of just the first (requires use_ocr=true)
actions.runExtract.props.use_ocr.descrip: Enable OCR processing (required for gpt-3.5-turbo or OCR-related parameters)
actions.uploadDocument.description: Uploads a document to a DocumentPro parser
actions.uploadDocument.props.file.descri: The document file to upload (PDF, JPEG, PNG, or TIFF, max 6MB)
auth.description:
To get your DocumentPro API Key:

1. **Login** to your DocumentPro account
2. **Go to** https://app.documentpro.ai/workflows
3. **Select** a workflow
4. **Change tab** to "Workflow" from the top bar
5. **Find** the "Upload" tab
6. **Click** "Upload via API"
7. **Click** the "Generate API Key" button
8. **Copy** your API key and paste it here
description: DocumentPro is an AI-powered document processing platform that automates data extraction from various document types using advanced machine learning algorithms.
triggers.newDocument.description: Triggers when a new document is uploaded to DocumentPro
**In DocumentPro Dashboard:**
   - Navigate to your desired Workflow
   - Go to the "Workflow" tab
   - Find the "Webhook Notification" option in the export section
   - Set the Webhook Endpoint URL to:
            ```text
			{{webhookUrl}}
			```
   - Click Save
